_about: Top sites by Firefox pageload-event share, trailing 7 days. Desktop and mobile are kept SEPARATE and applied by platform: desktop OSes (windows/macos/linux) use the 'desktop' list; android uses the 'mobile' list. A site is classified into the highest tier it reaches on any relevant list. Rank 1-50 = major, 51-5000 = common, 5001+ = rare. Regenerate with build_top_sites.py.
